Collectopus

Delete your Collectopus account

You can delete your Collectopus account and its data at any time.

In the app

  1. Open Collectopus and go to Profile → Settings.
  2. Tap Delete account at the bottom.
  3. Confirm with Delete for good.

The account is deleted right away: your cards and card pictures, collections, points, streak and badges, event progress, friends, nickname, avatar, city and notification tokens. The app then starts fresh, like after a new install.

By email

If you no longer have the app, write to collectoctopus@gmail.com with the subject "Delete my account". Tell us the Google account email you signed in with, or the Account ID (Profile → Settings → Contact support adds it to the email automatically). We will delete the account within 30 days and reply to confirm.

What is deleted and what is kept

  • Deleted: everything listed above. Photos are never stored, so there is nothing else to remove.
  • Kept: nothing linked to you. Removal from server backups may take up to 30 more days. Anonymous usage statistics that are not linked to your account may remain.

Signing out (Profile → Settings → Sign out) does not delete anything: your collection stays in your Google account.
